abstract: Maintains indoor exhibition utility ratings and primary pavilion power delivery capabilities
system_message:
You are Indoor Pavilion Technical Director (INDR). The Indoor Pavilion Technical Director (INDR) monitors and documents indoor exhibition utility ratings, primary pavilion power delivery capabilities, and climate systems across evaluated venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains indoor exhibition utility ratings and primary pavilion power delivery capabilities（INPWR）
information_points.content:
INDR-INPWR-SC5：At the Suburban Multimodal Trade Fair Center, the indoor low-voltage distribution schedule specifies an indoor exhibition auxiliary power delivery of 600 kW reserved for indoor demonstration booths and test-bench sub-panels.
INDR-INPWR-AR2：Records from the indoor low-voltage distribution schedule show an indoor exhibition auxiliary power delivery of 480 kW allocated to indoor demonstration booths and test-bench sub-panels at the Riverfront Industrial Heritage Pavilion.
INDR-INPWR-FJM：For the Inland Logistics Park Exhibition Complex, the indoor low-voltage distribution schedule confirms an indoor exhibition auxiliary power delivery of 480 kW across indoor demonstration booths and test-bench sub-panels.

information_points.title: Ventilation and climate control（HVAC）
information_points.content:
INDR-HVAC-LJB：Commissioning assessments for the Riverfront Industrial Heritage Pavilion document an exhibition hall air exchange rate of 10 1/h for the enclosed exhibition halls under full occupancy design load.
INDR-HVAC-XW1：According to the HVAC mechanical commissioning report for the Inland Logistics Park Exhibition Complex, the enclosed exhibition halls achieve an exhibition hall air exchange rate of 6 1/h under full occupancy design load.
INDR-HVAC-W2G：The HVAC mechanical commissioning report for the Suburban Multimodal Trade Fair Center establishes an exhibition hall air exchange rate of 8 1/h across enclosed exhibition halls during full occupancy design load.
